tags.effort_rationale: A responsive CSS correction and inclusive chart data selection with focused build and mobile interaction review.

objective: Fix mobile seasonality heatmap month alignment and expose a horizontally selectable partial 2026 chart line while preserving complete-year averages.

evidence: 2026-11-01: npm run build passed after the heatmap and year-selector layout changes. Vite emitted the existing bundle-size advisory only.
2026-11-01: npm run build -- --mode pages passed and emitted the standalone explorer assets under artifacts/seasonality.

checks.description: At phone viewport, verify page width, contained month scrolling/alignment, 2026 partial series and year focus/toggle.
evidence: 2026-11-01: Headless Chrome emulated 390×844 CSS pixels. documentElement.scrollWidth=390; heatmap client/scroll widths=338/800; month header/data x positions both 208; year strip client/scroll widths=338/1758. The all-years chart rendered 369 month points (360 complete-year + 9 2026). Clicking 2026 set aria-pressed=true; caption identified September cutoff; clicking it again restored the all-years state.
2026-11-01: scripts/planning/validate_ticket.py accepted the PRSG-168 manifest and all five scoped paths.

acceptance.description: Mobile heatmap scrolls within its panel, month headings remain aligned to cells and the selected series name remains visible without document-level horizontal overflow.
evidence: At 390 CSS px, page width matched viewport; month header and value grid shared the same x-position while the inner heatmap retained its own horizontal scroll range.

acceptance.description: Year selector is horizontally scrollable; all-years chart exposes 2026 with nine months through September and the year focus/toggle works.
evidence: The year strip scroll width exceeded its client width; 2026 was selectable. The chart contained 369 points, representing 30 complete years plus the nine available 2026 months. Focus and restore were verified.

acceptance.description: Standard and Pages production builds pass; historical heatmap averages remain based on complete years.
evidence: Both production builds passed. Complete-year filtering remains in the all-years heatmap and month-average path; partial 2026 is included only as an available chart year.
Ticket manifest and supplied change paths passed scope validation.
